s.equalizer_footer: Shapes the sound inside BitChord, before it reaches the system.
s.equalizer_broad_footer: Drag left for a warmer sound and right for a brighter one; down scoops the middle, up brings it forward. Broad moves wide stretches of the spectrum at once.
s.equalizer_focused_footer: Drag left for a warmer sound and right for a brighter one; down scoops the middle, up brings it forward. Focused works on narrower stretches, so it changes less around what it moves.
s.equalizer_bands_footer: Moving a band leaves the preset behind and the curve becomes your own.
s.equalizer_balance_footer: Shifts the sound towards one ear by quietening the other.

s.system_equalizer_footer: Runs after BitChord's, on the whole audio session. Using both applies both.

s.wear_os_sent: Terkirim — selesaikan di jam tangan jika diminta
s.wear_os_step_wifi: Hubungkan jam tangan ke Wi-Fi yang sama dengan ponsel ini.
s.wear_os_step_developer: Aktifkan Opsi pengembang di jam tangan. Galaxy Watch: Pengaturan → Tentang jam tangan → Informasi perangkat lunak → ketuk Versi perangkat lunak lima kali. Pixel Watch: Pengaturan → Sistem → Tentang → ketuk Nomor build tujuh kali.
s.wear_os_step_debugging: Di Opsi pengembang, aktifkan Debugging ADB dan Debugging nirkabel.
s.wear_os_step_pair: Ketuk Pasangkan perangkat baru, lalu masukkan kode enam digit yang ditampilkan jam tangan.
s.wear_os_searching: Mencari jam tangan Anda di Wi-Fi…
s.wear_os_installing: Memasang BitChord di jam tangan Anda…
s.wear_os_installed: Terpasang. Anda dapat mematikan Debugging nirkabel lagi.
s.wear_os_failed: Gagal (%1$s). Periksa kodenya dan coba lagi.
s.wear_os_unsupported: Memasang di jam tangan memerlukan Android 11 atau lebih baru di ponsel ini.
